incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty: Page fired for inference-service - high 5xx rate (eu-prod). Alert: inference-hotspot-high-5xx. Dashboard: https://dash.prod/redwood/alerts/174210

pagerbot: Page 12345 -> triggered 1m ago. Escalation policy: default-oncall -> will auto-escalate in 3m.

sarah: Acked. I'm on the bridge: https://meet.prod/bridge/174210

kai: assigning to emma (EU oncall) — cross-regional customers impacted, handoff in 1m :white_check_mark: 

emma-oncall-eu: Taking ownership. ETA 2m. Starting investigation, checking pod restarts and KV cache metrics.

mike: any customer-visible errors? Logs or sample trace ids?

sarah: customers see 5xx on embeddings and streaming endpoints — spike began ~1742104000. CS notified: @nina-cs

nina-cs: Thanks — will prep an outbound if impact confirmed. Holding for update.

emma-oncall-eu: found repeated pod evictions on inference-worker-3, reason: PVC mount timeout. K8s events:

emma-oncall-eu: ```Warning  FailedMount  kubelet, inference-worker-3  MountVolume.MountDevice failed for volume "kvcache-pvc" : rpc error: code = DeadlineExceeded desc = context deadline exceeded``` 

mike: hmm, that's likely the k8s storage issue causing KV cache boot failures -> 5xx. Can we restart pod or remount?

emma-oncall-eu: rolling restart of inference-worker-3 initiated: `kubectl rollout restart deployment/inference-worker -n prod-eu --field-selector metadata.name=inference-worker-3`

sarah: quick check: any fallback routing triggered? Are requests being retried to other regions?

kai: routing policy showed automatic fallback to us-west for 12% of requests; most still hit eu because sticky routing.

emma-oncall-eu: pod restarted — healthchecks passing. Observability: 5xx count dropping, p95 latency returning to baseline. Monitoring: https://dash.prod/redwood/inference/eu

pagerbot: Page auto-escalation suppressed (owner assigned).

sarah: great. Please keep monitoring 15m, we'll decide whether to notify customers. @nina-cs please hold until stable.

nina-cs: holding. Will send blurb if rates don't normalize in 10m.

emma-oncall-eu: confirming stable for 5m, no more evictions. Will file a follow-up runbook note and postmortem.

mike: suggest we add PVC mount timeout alert to storage team runbook.

sarah: agreed. Emma — can you capture root cause and next steps in incidents board?

emma-oncall-eu: yup — creating incident ticket and assigning to eng-storage. brief summary in incident tracker: https://incidents.prod/redwood/INC-174210

incident-bot: Page resolved (12345). Duration: ~12m. Owner: emma-oncall-eu.

sarah: thanks all. :thumbsup:
